description: This Java class `JsonObjectExtractAdapter` implements the `TextMap` interface for extracting properties from a Vert.x `JsonObject`. It provides an iterator to traverse the JSON properties as key-value string pairs for use in tracing operations, but does not support insertion via the `put` method.

classes.name: JsonObjectExtractAdapter
classes.description: An adapter class that wraps a Vert.x `JsonObject` to implement the `TextMap` interface for extracting trace context propagation information.

methods.name: JsonObjectExtractAdapter
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the adapter with a non-null `JsonObject`.

methods.name: iterator
methods.description: Returns an iterator over the JSON object's properties as key-value string pairs for traversal.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Unsupported operation for this adapter; throws `UnsupportedOperationException`.
